name: BSP_HitRecord_SetShot

Body 00470350-0047036F, __thiscall(record, shot). record+4h = shot and, when the shot is non-null, record+14h = shot->vtable[54h]() in ST(0). record+14h is the hull damage base 00470510 reads, so the base comes straight from the shot. Sites: 0084C0C3 with the shot interface's +0CCh, 009044F4, 0084BBB1, 0080A94E and 00819B9C.

name: BSP_HitRecord_HullDamage

name: BSP_HitRecord_WorstPart
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_hit_narrowphase, read-only analysis. docs/HIT_NARROWPHASE.md.
